The '''Second Great Droid Revolution''', also known as the '''Second Droid Revolution''', was a short-lived and unsuccessful [[Droid/Legends|droid]] revolt on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]]. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Archa Sabis]] uploaded a virus into the droid population which caused several [[Police speeder|police cruisers]] and [[EVS Construction Droid|EVS Construction droids]] to [[Archa Sabis's droid army|rebel]] [[Droid supremacy|against]] their sentient masters. Following the suppression of the rising, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was able to exploit [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid sentiment]].
